title: Factory settle misclassifies successful DEO receipts, skips revalidation, and executes redundant repair candidates after convergence

symptom.delivery_fact: package.json was physically updated with @types/node but Factory still marked the settle task failed

physical_evidence.parent_registry: first DEO wave closed with receipt_count=2 and aborted_count=2
physical_evidence.operation_lifecycle: two forward members reached EFFECT_STARTED then RECEIPT_COMMITTED with receipt_outcome=succeeded; two rollback contingencies were correctly aborted
physical_evidence.workspace_manifest: devDependencies contains @types/node ^22.10.0 after the settle write
physical_evidence.remaining_verifier_failure: node_modules was installed before the manifest mutation, so tsc still reported TS2688 until dependencies were refreshed
physical_evidence.verification_delivery: npm build exit 0, npm test exit 0, Playwright HTTP 200 with nonblank canvas and no console/resource errors
physical_evidence.verification_control_plane_residual: the first candidate produced two succeeded receipts and reduced diagnostics 6->0, but two later candidates added a dead-letter parent; completed settlement then correctly failed with settlement_effect_outcome_conflict

root_cause.producer_contract: commit_materialization_deferred_repairs returns normalized BatchReceipt dictionaries using success_count/failure_count and nested result.status
root_cause.consumer_bug: Factory checked only receipt.success is True, a field canonical BatchReceipt does not contain
root_cause.secondary_bug: Factory did not refresh dependencies or rerun materialization diagnostics after successful manifest writes
root_cause.tertiary_bug: Factory treated alternative repair candidates as mandatory sequential effects and executed later candidates after the physical verifier was already green, polluting one TaskRuntime attempt with avoidable dead-letter evidence

implemented_fix: Interpret canonical BatchReceipt success_count/failure_count and nested result statuses while preserving legacy receipt compatibility.
After at least one authoritative DEO success, refresh the TypeScript toolchain and rerun materialization diagnostics.
Commit deferred repair candidates one at a time with distinct turn identities; stop immediately after authoritative revalidation reaches zero diagnostics.
Allow partial repair-wave failure only when authoritative post-commit diagnostics are empty; otherwise remain fail-closed.
Expose pre/post diagnostic counts and failed receipt counts in the settle projection.
required_tests: canonical BatchReceipt with success_count=1 is accepted without a top-level success flag
post-commit dependency refresh runs once after an authoritative write
post-commit diagnostics must be empty before settle reports success
deferred repair with no successful receipt remains failed
legacy top-level success receipt remains compatible
later repair candidates are not admitted after the first candidate reaches verified convergence
evidence: combined materialization settle + TaskRuntime settlement regression: 62 passed
